source.hypothesis: A simulation stop inside a scheduled fixed RECON and FOLLOW mission may be rejected by the native converter. The v1.0.1 paired probe observed Operations error #204; this revised gate tests that as a bounded input-acceptance limit, not as an unfinished-mission behavior claim.

model.precedent: one fixed RECON starts hour 8, nominal duration 4, expected return hour 12 without failure
model.dependent: one fixed FOLLOW scheduled hour 10, nominal duration 2, may assign at hour 9
model.dependency: one explicit FOLLOW START depends on RECON at hour 8; paired control omits only this row and changes label
model.delta_from_parent: Control.SIMPE/RCEND and both explicit ResultCollection MISSION/SYSTEM RCEND values 24 to 11 hours, plus provenance label; all other input fields remain inherited from accepted A13

predeclared_native_gate: The paired source inputs differ only in one MissionDependence START row and provenance label; each exact parent delta is recorded. The 13 control and 14 dependency populated source business tables must import and export exactly.

Fresh immutable session-0 SSH native runs use Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue and preserve GUI PID 13340/session/start identity. Source and raw outputs must be fingerprinted before and after execution.

Both runs must reproduce exactly one relevant Operations converter error #204, reporting that some missions may not return before the simulation period ends, with only expected logging/no-items warnings #108/#126. Any unrelated or additional error is NO-GO.

Calculation process exit code zero is not accepted as simulation success: each failed conversion must leave a four-byte invalid SXO, no native event log, no JSON report and no claimed 22-bin behavior. Import/export and the source-row roundtrip must still pass.

The same rejection must occur with and without the START row, demonstrating only that this horizon construction is invalid independently of this one dependency row. It does not prove a universal rule for all unfinished missions or any runtime START behavior.
A separate read-only reviewer independently checks source lineage, immutable raw closures, host guards, conversion diagnostics and absent outputs without importing the author validator.
limits: This is one converter-level negative input case; no mission behavior or 22-bin report is accepted. Other unfinished scenarios, including a genuinely missing/never-returning precedent, remain untested.

The inherited RECON MSUCPT=0.25 may mark internal success before hour 11 even though no success event is logged; this probe tests the separate return requirement, not failure to reach the success point.
No multiple precedents, other schedules, failures, cross-unit identities, GUI visual evidence or cross-engine parity are accepted.

excluded_diagnostics.reason: Static-only pre-run NO-GO: Control.SIMPE/RCEND were shortened to 11, but explicit ResultCollection MISSION/SYSTEM RCEND stayed at 24, conflicting with the predeclared 22-bin 0–11 report gate. No v1.0.0 native run occurred.

The revised report windows were coherent, but both guarded native calculations rejected Operations error #204 and produced four-byte SXO files. This contradicted the predeclared zero-error behavioral gate, so those sealed runs remain diagnostic; no v1.0.1 mission behavior is published.
